command.name: convert to table
command.description: Converts text within a text range to a table.

parameter.name: separator
parameter.description: Specifies the character used to separate text into cells.

parameter.name: number of rows
parameter.description: The number of rows in the table. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word sets the number of rows, based on the contents of the text range.

parameter.name: number of columns
parameter.description: The number of columns in the table. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word sets the number of rows, based on the contents of the text range.

parameter.name: initial column width
parameter.description: The initial width of each column, in points. If this argument is omitted, Word calculates and adjusts the column width so that the table stretches from margin to margin.

parameter.name: table format
parameter.description: Specifies one of the predefined formats

parameter.name: apply borders
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the border properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply shading
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the shading properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply font
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the font properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply color
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the color properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply heading rows
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the heading-row properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply last row
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the last-row properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply first column
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the first-column properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: apply last column
parameter.description: Set to true to apply the last-column properties of the specified format.

parameter.name: auto fit
parameter.description: Set to true to decrease the width of the table columns as much as possible without changing the way text wraps in the cells.

parameter.name: auto fit behavior
parameter.description: Sets the auto fit rules for how Word sizes a table.

parameter.name: default table behavior
parameter.description: Sets a value that specifies whether Microsoft Word automatically resizes cells in a table to fit the contents.
